name: softcollie
description: The public skill stack of SoftCollie / ShephERP for Claude Code.

plugins.name: vibecoding-docs
plugins.description: Interactively generates the 6 planning documents you want before vibecoding (PRD, TRD, UI/UX, AppFlow, backend schema and implementation plan) into docs/CLAUDE/, and references them from the root CLAUDE.md. Analyzes existing projects to infer the context instead of asking from scratch.

plugins.name: watch-for-me
plugins.description: Watches a video for you without playing it: from a local path or a URL (Instagram, YouTube, TikTok…) it extracts key frames (interval sampling + scene-cut detection), contact sheets and an optional audio transcript, summarizes the content and leaves the agent ready to answer questions about the video. Cross-platform; manages its own dependencies.
